06QUESTIONS
Plain
answers.
A clear view of what's working.
More detail is in the docs.
01What can I use today?
Explore public Solana pool data, view market reference prices, connect your wallet, save launch drafts and use the position simulator. Launches continue on pump.fun; swaps continue on Jupiter.
02Are trades private?
No. Solana transactions are public. This version has no shielded vault or privacy program, and never asks for a shielding deposit.
03Does Solvia hold my funds?
No. Wallet connection is read-only. External venues handle their own transactions and ask you to review and sign in your wallet.
04Is there a project token?
No official mint address has been supplied. The contract-address area stays CA soon until an address is confirmed.
05Is the leverage simulator a live trade?
No. It is a local, simplified risk model. No position is opened and the calculation excludes fees, funding and venue-specific liquidation rules.
